limitations: Fresh processes replace historical reused batches; the change in outcome is not solely attributable to code changes.
Concurrent jobs use recorded CPU sets on a shared host. Timings are observations, not causal speedup estimates.
Overall verifier budgets exclude some frontend/startup work; recorded wall times include the whole session.
Unexpected proof failures do not resolve a timeout or prove the input incorrect.
Killed diagnostic streams retain an unanswered final check and incomplete solver metadata.
All experiments are retained; later configurations/repeats do not overwrite the first pass.
No runtime code or defaults changed, no full corpus rerun, and no live Prusti worktree changes.
